---
title: "Contact"
description: "Book a Google Meet call or send SisengAI a message."
toc: false
---

::: {.hero-section .contact-hero}
<span class="eyebrow-line">Start with one workflow</span>

# Book a call or send a considered note.

<p class="hero-subtitle">Bring the repetitive task you want to improve. We’ll decide whether it is a sensible candidate for automation and what to do next.</p>

<div class="meeting-card">
  <div class="meeting-icon">G</div>
  <div><strong>AI automation fit call</strong><p>20 minutes · Google Meet · booking confirmation arrives by email</p></div>
  <a href="https://calendar.app.google/d7Ttfbm1Masri4vB8" class="btn btn-primary">Choose a time</a>
</div>
:::

::: {.contact-note-section}
<div class="contact-note-intro">
  <span class="section-label">Prefer email?</span>
  <h2>Tell me what you are trying to improve.</h2>
  <p>A little context is enough: the work that repeats, who does it now, and what a better outcome would look like.</p>
  <p class="contact-note-detail">Your note is sent directly and privately to Ricky.Macharm@SisengAI.com.</p>
</div>

<form id="email-contact-form" class="email-contact-form">
<div class="contact-form-grid">
<p><label for="contact-name">Your name</label><input id="contact-name" name="name" autocomplete="name" minlength="2" maxlength="100" required></p>
<p><label for="contact-email">Your email</label><input id="contact-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></p>
</div>
<p><label for="contact-subject">What would you like to discuss?</label><input id="contact-subject" name="subject" placeholder="For example: an AI assistant for client research" minlength="3" maxlength="160" required></p>
<p><label for="contact-message">A little context</label><textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows="6" placeholder="What is happening now, and what would you like to be easier?" minlength="10" maxlength="5000" required></textarea></p>
<p class="contact-honeypot" aria-hidden="true"><label for="contact-company">Company</label><input id="contact-company" name="company" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></p>
<div class="contact-form-action"><button id="contact-submit" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send message <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button><p id="contact-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p></div>
</form>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  const endpoint = "https://bot.sisengai.com/contact";
  const form = document.querySelector("#email-contact-form");
  const status = document.querySelector("#contact-form-status");
  const submit = document.querySelector("#contact-submit");
  const initialButton = submit.innerHTML;

  const readError = async (response) => {
    try {
      const payload = await response.json();
      if (typeof payload.detail === "string") return payload.detail;
      if (payload.detail && payload.detail.errors) return Object.values(payload.detail.errors).join(" ");
    } catch (_) {}
    return "Your message could not be sent right now. Please book a call instead.";
  };

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const body = {
      name: document.querySelector("#contact-name").value.trim(),
      email: document.querySelector("#contact-email").value.trim(),
      subject: document.querySelector("#contact-subject").value.trim(),
      message: document.querySelector("#contact-message").value.trim(),
      company: document.querySelector("#contact-company").value.trim()
    };
    submit.disabled = true;
    submit.textContent = "Sending…";
    status.className = "";
    status.textContent = "Sending your message directly to Ricky…";

    try {
      const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(await readError(response));
      form.reset();
      status.className = "success";
      status.textContent = "Message sent. Ricky will reply to the email address you provided.";
    } catch (error) {
      status.className = "error";
      status.textContent = error.message || "Your message could not be sent right now. Please book a call instead.";
    } finally {
      submit.disabled = false;
      submit.innerHTML = initialButton;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
